name: Bad Children
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of honoring and obeying parents, as seen in the command to honor father and mother for a long life (Exodus 20:12) and the severe consequences for striking or cursing them (Exodus 21:15,17). A stubborn and rebellious son who refuses correction is presented as a serious problem requiring firm discipline (Deuteronomy 21:18). Proverbs contrasts the joy a wise son brings with the grief caused by a foolish one, affirming that loving discipline is necessary to guide children rightly (Proverbs 10:1; 13:24).
